title: Inspection Grades and Their Consequences (Returns & Exchanges)
content:
The returns centre grades every unit of a Returns & Exchanges return at inspection. The grade decides whether the unit is accepted and what it carries.

## Grades

| Grade | Condition | Consequence |
|---|---|---|
| A | Unworn, tags attached | Accepted without fee |
| B | Unworn, tags detached | Accepted with a restocking fee where the return type charges restocking fees |
| C | Worn, washed, altered or damaged | As the return type sets: rejected and sent back at the send-back fee, or accepted as defective on a Quality Issue Return |
| Missing | Not in the parcel | Rejected |

## Clauses

1. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause setting the restocking fee per unit as the type's grade B percentage of the net unit price paid, rounded half up to the cent and capped at the type's per-unit cap, has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
2. > **Retired clause — no longer in force.** The clause providing that a footwear unit returned with no original box, or with its original box damaged or used as the shipping carton, carries the type's missing box fee per unit has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.
3. When a footwear unit carries both a restocking fee and a box fee, both are withheld.
4. Restocking and box fees are waived when the returning customer's Marlowe Rewards tier carries the restocking fee waiver perk on the authorization date. A Gift Return never uses the recipient's or the purchaser's tier.
5. A fee is never larger than the value credited for the unit it is charged on.
6. Fees are assessed only once the return is in status inspected.

## By return status

| Return status | Fees may be assessed |
|---|---|
| Inspected | Yes |
| Authorized, in transit, received | No — inspection has not been posted |
| Settled, cancelled, expired | No — the return is not in status inspected |

Example (hypothetical): on a Store Credit Return a pair of trainers comes back unworn with the tags detached and without its box; the unit is grade B, it is accepted, and both a restocking fee and a box fee are withheld on it — unless the customer's Marlowe Rewards tier carries the restocking fee waiver perk on the authorization date, in which case both are waived.

superseded_clauses: the fee per unit is `restocking_fee_pct_grade_b` percent of the net unit price paid, rounded half up to the cent and capped at `restocking_fee_cap_per_unit_usd`
A footwear unit whose box_condition is no_original_box or original_box_damaged_or_used_as_shipper carries `missing_box_fee_usd` per unit
